messages:
Ethan (SE): Kickoff sync — want to align on Acme POC success criteria, prompt inventory, and baseline prompts. @Olivia can you drop the top 3 user flows you want covered?
Priya (AE): Quick note: customer cares about latency <= 300ms 95th, and per-query cost targets. They asked about max monthly spend cap.
Olivia (Customer PM): Top flows: 1) customer support summarization; 2) contract clause extraction; 3) contextual reply suggestion in support UI. We want quality >= 0.85 on ROUGE-L for summaries and precision >= 0.9 on key clause extraction. Timeline: 3-week POC.
Ethan (SE): Perfect. For prompts, I'll capture inventory and propose baselines. Need any red-team or exact denial/PII constraints?
Sam (Security): Data must stay in VPC (private deployment), no raw transcripts stored after 7 days, KMS integration required. Also will send completed security questionnaire (SOC/ISO fields).
Jorge (SRE): For dedicated capacity, we can provision a small pool — estimate 2x A10 equivalent GPUs for baseline. Need expected qps to finalize.
Priya (AE): FYI they're expecting a price anchor for 3-week eval + optional month of reserved capacity. Can we table an initial estimate?
Ethan (SE): I'll give a conservative price: $6k for the 3-week POC infra + $2k for setup & eval work. Confirm qps?
Olivia (Customer PM): Peak qps ~ 12, average 4. Mostly short prompts except summarization which is longer (~600 tokens).
Maya (Product): For summarization, let's use a length-optimized baseline prompt and measure latency and quality. We'll run two prompt variants: short-prefix and context-window.
Ethan (SE): Adding proposed baseline prompts below — these are what we'll evaluate against their datasets. Please review.
Ethan (SE): ```
# Summarization baseline
Prompt: "Summarize the customer support conversation in 3 bullets with action items. Keep each bullet <= 30 words."
# Clause extraction baseline
Prompt: "Extract contract clauses related to 'termination' and return JSON array of {clause_text, clause_type, confidence}."
# Reply suggestion baseline
Prompt: "Given the user message and conversation history, suggest 3 candidate replies ranked by helpfulness."
```
Priya (AE): Those look good. We should add an eval set size per flow (suggest 200 samples each).
Ethan (SE): Agreed — propose 200 eval examples per flow. We'll run automatic metrics + small manual review (20 samples each) for edge cases.
Olivia (Customer PM): 200 each is fine. For manual review, we can provide SME time.
Sam (Security): Quick check — make sure prompts do not include customer PII in the prompt text for privacy. Use reference IDs instead.
Ethan (SE): Noted. We'll sanitize inputs during eval. Also plan to enable KV prefix caching for repeated retrieval prompts — should help p99 latency.
Jorge (SRE): On the infra side, with avg 4 qps and batching window of 20ms we can meet 300ms 95th for summary flows. Will validate after first day of runs.
Maya (Product): For success criteria, propose: Summarization ROUGE-L >= 0.85 and human helpfulness >= 4/5; Clause extraction precision >= 0.9; Reply suggestion CTR up 8% in staged UI. Any objections?
Olivia (Customer PM): Sounds aligned. Add acceptance: no major PII leakage incidents and SLA 95% availability during test.
Priya (AE): I'll confirm the purchase order path for the optional reserved month. Also flag: they asked about model rollbacks & fallback rules.
Ethan (SE): We'll configure automatic fallback to smaller model variant if latencies spike; document in runbook.
Sam (Security): Send me the sanitized prompt list and the data flow diagram; I'll sign off on encryption at rest/in transit items.
Ethan (SE): Will do. Next steps: (1) I’ll compile prompt inventory + eval plan by EOD tomorrow; (2) Jorge to provision test infra by Friday; (3) Sam to review security artifacts early next week; (4) Priya to confirm PO path.
Priya (AE): I'll follow up with procurement contact.
Olivia (Customer PM): Thanks all — excited to get started.
Redwood Bot: Reminder: shared drive folder created — "acme-poc/artifacts".
Ethan (SE): Awesome. Closing action: I'll post the prompt inventory doc here when ready. :thumbsup:
